en.title: Short answers and question tags
en.summary: A short answer repeats the auxiliary, and a question tag asks for agreement.

paragraphs: A short answer repeats the auxiliary. A question tag is a short question added to a statement to ask for agreement or to check a fact. Both are very common in speech, and both depend on the auxiliary of the first sentence.

A tag has the same auxiliary as the statement but the opposite meaning: a positive statement has a negative tag, and a negative statement has a positive tag. If the statement has no auxiliary, the tag uses do, does or did. The tag has the subject as a pronoun.

blocks.html:
StatementTag
It is cold,isn't it?
You can swim,can't you?
They didn't come,did they?
She likes tea,doesn't she?
I am late,aren't I?

paragraphs: If the voice rises on the tag, the speaker really asks. If the voice falls, the speaker expects agreement and only checks. It's a nice day, isn't it? with a falling voice is a polite remark.
After I am the tag is aren't I? After an imperative the tag is will you? or won't you?: Open the door, will you? After let's the tag is shall we?

items: Wrong: **You like tea, don't it?** Right: **You like tea, don't you?**
Wrong: **She is here, is she?** (when you expect it) Right: **She is here, isn't she?**
Wrong: **Are you ready? Yes, I ready.** Right: **Yes, I am.**

ro.title: Răspunsuri scurte și întrebări de confirmare
ro.summary: În limba română folosim expresii scurte precum „nu-i așa?” și repetăm verbul pentru a confirma o afirmație.

paragraphs: Limba română nu are întrebări de confirmare formate cu verbe auxiliare. Folosim la final expresii simple precum „nu-i așa?” sau „nu?”. Pentru un răspuns scurt, spunem „da”, „nu” ori repetăm verbul.

items: Tu vii mâine la curs, **nu-i așa?**

paragraphs: Adăugați formula de confirmare la final, după o virgulă. Aceste expresii scurte au aceeași formă pentru orice persoană. Pentru răspunsul scurt, puteți repeta simplu verbul din întrebare.

blocks.html:
AfirmațieÎntrebare de confirmareRăspuns scurt
Ești gata,nu-i așa?Da, sunt gata.
Vii cu noi,nu?Da, vin.
Ai mâncat,așa-i?Da, am mâncat.
Nu pleci încă,nu-i așa?Nu, nu plec.
